entries.german:
Ulrich von Weichseln bekennt, dass ihm auf die Pfarrkirche zu Kirchschlag, die Wok von Krumau (Ceský Krumlov) vor Jahren dem Kloster Schlägl gegeben hatte, und auf deren Dotation kein Recht zustehe.

In nomine Domini Amen. Ego Vdalricus de Weichseln notum esse cupio Vniuersis presentes audituris literas seu lecturis, quod evolutis plurimis annis, antequam emissem hereditatem seu forum Khirchschlag Dominus Woko pie memorie dictus de Krummau dedit et contulit domui B. Virginis in Plaga Patauiensis diocesis pro damnis illatis et remedio anime sue ecclesiam in Khirchslag cum tribus plenis mansis in foro ibidem in Khirchslag ad dotem spectantibus pleno iure et omni libertate nullis pactis et condicionibus interpositis libere et absolute in perpetuum possidendam. Ergo ego predictus Vdalricus, ex quo emi predictam hereditatem volo, vt nulli super his dubium oriatur, quod Ego nullam habeo ambagibus pretermissis justitiam nec aliquis heredum ac successorum meorum habere debebit in jam dictam Ecclesiam in Khirchslag aut in bonis ipsius Ecclesie supradictis sive in judiciis vel exactionibus seu in aliis quibuscunque grauaminibus faciendis, nisi quod sine omni vtilitate et eciam grauamine Plebani, quemcunque Prepositus jam fate Domus B. Virginis ibi locauerit, sicut bona propria pro peccatis nostris tenebimus defensare. Si autem, quod absit, per me aut per aliquem heredum seu successorum nostrorum secus attentatum uel actum fuerit, Prepositus prescripte Domus B. Virginis uel Plebanus de Kirchschlag se defendere poterunt et debebunt presencium testimonio literarum. Vt autem prescripta robur habeant firmitatis, presentes literas dedi Domui B. Virginis in Plaga et fratribus ibidem Sigilli Domini mei Heinrici von Rosenberg et mei proprii appensionibus fideliter roboratas. Huius rei testes sunt Waczlaus Purgrauius de Rosenberg, Wisco procurator, Traianus, Pribislaus, Philippus fratres de Lebnicz, Elblinus, Busco, Jaclinus fratres dicti de Horrach, Busco de Rubn, Dworzata de Cypin, Dominicus de Passawerschlag Nicolaus de Dworzatschlag et alii quam plures. Datum anno Domini m. ccc. jn translacione B. Nicolai Episcopi et Confessoris.
entries.english:
Ulrich von Weichseln acknowledges that he holds no rights over the parish church of Kirchschlag, which Wok of Krumau (Ceský Krumlov) had given years earlier to Schlägl Monastery, nor over its endowment.

In the name of the Lord, Amen. I, Vdalricus [Ulrich] von Weichseln, wish it to be known to all who hear or read these present letters, that after many years had passed, before I purchased the inheritance and market of Kirchschlag, the lord Woko of pious memory, called of Krummau, gave and conferred upon the house of the Blessed Virgin in Plaga (Schlägl), a diocese of Passau, for damages suffered and for the remedy of his soul, the church at Kirchslag with three full manses at the market there in Kirchschlag pertaining to its endowment, with full right and every liberty, no agreements or conditions being interposed, freely and absolutely to be possessed in perpetuity. Therefore I, aforesaid Vdalricus, since I wish to purchase the aforementioned inheritance, that no doubt may arise concerning these matters, do declare without circumlocution that I have no jurisdiction, nor shall any of my heirs or successors have any, over the said church at Kirchslag or over the goods of the same church aforesaid, whether in courts or exactions or in any other grievances to be made, except that without any utility and even burden to the rector, whomsoever the provost of the aforesaid house of the Blessed Virgin shall appoint there, we shall defend as our own property for our sins. But if, God forbid, something contrary should be attempted or done by me or by any of my heirs or successors, the provost of the said house of the Blessed Virgin or the rector of Kirchslag may and shall defend themselves by the testimony of these present letters. That the aforesaid matters may have firm strength, I have given these letters to the house of the Blessed Virgin in Plaga and the brothers there, faithfully strengthened by the affixing of the seal of my lord Heinrich von Rosenberg and of my own. The witnesses are: Waczlaus, steward of Rosenberg; Wisco the procurator; Traianus, Pribislaus, Philippus, brothers of Lebnicz; Elblinus, Busco, Jaclinus, brothers called of Horrach; Busco of Rubn; Dworzata of Cypin; Dominicus of Passawerschlag; Nicolaus of Dworzatschlag and many others. Given in the year of the Lord 1300, on the translation of Saint Nicholas, Bishop and Confessor.
